title: setLocation
body:
## setLocation

Write declared GPS positions into new copies of the same container (JPEG, TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP or HEIF with an existing Exif item): latitude and longitude as signed decimal degrees exactly as declared, an optional altitude with an explicit ellipsoidal or sea-level reference, the datum and a horizontal error text, with declared handling of stale GPS and XMP companions and of altitudes the file's metadata edition cannot express.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Positions are your declaration, not a measurement: nothing is verified or geocoded, and place names (IPTC city, XMP location) are not updated.
- The 2e-10 degree bound is how precisely the stored rationals hold your decimal, not the accuracy of the position.
- An altitude is written only with the reference you declare and only where the edition can express it; there is no vertical datum conversion and no ExifVersion promotion. Writing that would change the meaning of an untouched height is refused for that item.
- Removing stale companions (direction, speed, time stamps, XMP positions) is planned before the write; keeping them can leave a direction that no longer matches the position.
- A TIFF, DNG, PNG or WebP without an Exif block gets one when the policy allows; a HEIF file never gets a new Exif item (HEIF_METADATA_ITEM_CREATION_UNSUPPORTED).

Native binding: `one perl exiftool -config "" -n process per item: -GPS:TAG=value and -XMP-exif:TAG=value assignments of decimal-degree coordinates, explicit references and the declared companions, stale GPS values removed as declared (never authored as tags); -o stage/ID.jpg captured/ID.jpg`. Output kind: `["image","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `apply` | write (default) writes the new copies and publishes the plan with the report; plan publishes the plan and the reports without writing any copy. The plan can be applied later with the plan option, and only to the captures it was made for. | `{"type":"enum","values":["write","plan"]}` | omitted |
| `positions` | Declared positions for named photos. A photo without an entry takes default, and one with neither is copied unchanged or refused by policy. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"latitude":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24},{"type":"number"}],"required":true},"longitude":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24},{"type":"number"}],"required":true},"altitude":{"type":"object","properties":{"meters":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24,"required":true},"reference":{"type":"enum","values":["seaLevel","ellipsoidal"],"required":true}}},"datum":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"horizontalErrorMeters":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24},"gpsUtc":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"item":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}}}` | omitted |
| `default` | A position for every photo that has no entry of its own in positions. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"latitude":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24},{"type":"number"}],"required":true},"longitude":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24},{"type":"number"}],"required":true},"altitude":{"type":"object","properties":{"meters":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24,"required":true},"reference":{"type":"enum","values":["seaLevel","ellipsoidal"],"required":true}}},"datum":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"horizontalErrorMeters":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24},"gpsUtc":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}}` | omitted |
| `policies` | How to resolve choices the data cannot decide. The accepted members depend on the operation: editMetadata (iptc, otherLanguages, exifEncoding, companionLoss), correctTime (sourceConflicts, preferFamily, subSecond, uncorrectedItems), setLocation (staleCompanions, xmp, createExif, altitudeNotExpressible, removeDirection, uncorrectedItems) and geotagFromTrack (those of setLocation plus gpsStamp and maxSpeedMetersPerSecond). Every member is optional; the effective plan echoes all of them with their defaults. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"staleCompanions":{"type":"enum","values":["remove","keep"]},"xmp":{"type":"enum","values":["ifPresent","always","remove"]},"createExif":{"type":"enum","values":["allow","refuse"]},"altitudeNotExpressible":{"type":"enum","values":["refuse","omitAltitude"]},"removeDirection":{"type":"boolean"},"uncorrectedItems":{"type":"enum","values":["copyUnchanged","refuseSlot"]}}}` | omitted |
| `plan` | Absolute path of a plan document published earlier by this operation with apply: plan. The run applies exactly that plan: the plan carries every other input of its operation, so combining it with them is refused, an edited plan is refused as inconsistent, and a capture that changed since the plan was made is refused as stale. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | omitted |
